PortDirectionEnum.description: determines whether the port is an inlet and outlet or both

In.description: Ports with the direction “In” can only be connected to ports with the direction “Out” or “InOut”.

Out.description: Ports with the direction “Out” can only be connected to ports with the direction “In” or “InOut”.

InOut.description: Ports with the direction “InOut” can be connected to ports with arbitrary directions.
